---
title: "Supreme arena defense squads"
type: learnings
description: "three disjoint defense squads with no repeated hero or artifact, scored against a weekly level baseline"
project: gamehelper
tags: [arena, squads]
---

Supreme arena asks for three defense squads at once. No hero and no artifact may appear in two
squads, and the weekly level baseline replaces raw levels, so the builder picks the three
squads jointly instead of greedily.
